_meta.what_this_is: A tiny weight matrix standing in for one layer of a model. Six channels (rows) of eight weights each. Five channels hold ordinary small weights in roughly [-1.5, 1.5]. Channel 5 holds ordinary weights PLUS one outlier (48.0) -- the kind of single large-magnitude activation/weight that real transformer layers grow. The outlier is the whole point: with one global scale (per-tensor), it stretches the quantization grid so far that every ordinary weight collapses onto almost no levels.
_meta.weights_are: A FIXTURE. Hand-authored small values plus one planted outlier, so per-tensor vs per-channel quantization error is exact and checkable. No model, no training.
_meta.format: channels: list of rows; each row is a list of float weights. outlier_channel names which row carries the planted outlier.
